comment: First runs of results/openrouter-2026-11-18 whose control read 0 cached tokens at the default ~2,500-token prompt (no observable cache), each with its run of its own with a ~8,000-token prompt (as cpa-latest-2026-11-06/L1b) once that exists (the chief's decision, m-10759). The first runs stay in manifest-entries.json as summary.py builds it; the assembler holds them out until their larger-prompt run exists.

entry.note: the run ended after its 5m checks, at the next check, on an upstream's answer (HTTP 504 "The operation was aborted", after a 429 of Google AI Studio ("google/gemini-4-carbon is temporarily rate-limited upstream. Please retry shortly, or add …")), which the probe's --stop-on-refusal read as a rate refusal and did not retry; the checks answered before it stand, later ages untested; OpenRouter's default route: 4 check(s) were answered by another upstream than the one their sample was primed on (5m-r1: primed on Google, answered by Google AI Studio: cold (0/7501 cached); 5m-r3: primed on Google, answered by Google AI Studio: cold (0/7548 cached); 2.5m-r2: primed on Google, answered by Google AI Studio: cold (0/7539 cached); 2.5m-r3~2: primed on Google, answered by Google AI Studio: cold (0/7534 cached)). Such a miss shows failed reuse through the default route, not expiry at the upstream; the same request with a ~2,500-token prompt (openrouter-2026-11-18/google--gemini-4-carbon) read no cached token at its control; this run with ~8,000 tokens read from cache at its control and is the measurement
